question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Awful
solution:
The correct answer is '**terrible**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word "**Awful**" describes something that is very bad or unpleasant (भयानक).

 
 
• **Example**: The weather was **awful **last weekend, with heavy rain and strong winds.
 
 
 
• The correct word "**Terrible**" means extremely bad or serious (भयानक).
 
 
• **Example**: The accident was **terrible**, resulting in several injuries.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is **terrible**.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inoffensive **means not likely to provoke dissent or offence; unobjectionable (आपत्तिजनक नहीं).
 
• **Delightful **means causing delight; charming or pleasing (मनोहर).
 
• **Acceptable **means able to be agreed on; suitable (स्वीकार्य).
